# Old Threads Co

> Affordable, hand-picked vintage clothing store in Orem, Utah. Specializing in vintage tees, denim, jackets, and rare one-of-one pieces from the 70s, 80s, 90s, and 2000s. New drops every Friday. Open Tuesday through Saturday, 2pm to 9pm.

Old Threads Co is a small, locally-owned vintage clothing store located in Orem, Utah. We hand-pick every piece in our shop — sourcing rare vintage tees, denim, sweatshirts, jackets, and one-of-one finds from estate sales, auctions, and decades of carefully curated collections. We rotate inventory weekly with new drops every Friday, and we sell both in-store and online via Depop.

## Location & Hours

- **Address:** 1111 S 1350 W, Suite F20, Orem, UT 84058
- **Phone:** (623) 262-0632
- **Hours:** Tuesday – Saturday, 2:00 PM – 9:00 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday.
- **Reviews:** 5.0 stars on Google
- **Founded:** 2023

## What we sell

- Vintage tees (single-stitch, band tees, college, sports, brand)
- Vintage denim (Levi's 501s, Carhartt, Wrangler, made-in-USA)
- Vintage jackets and outerwear (Carhartt Detroit, leather bombers, Champion, varsity)
- Vintage sweatshirts and hoodies (Champion Reverse Weave, Russell, college crewnecks)
- Rare and one-of-one pieces (90s Disney, NBA, NFL, music tours, branded vintage)
- Consignment from local Utah collectors

## How to buy

- **In person:** Visit the shop at 1111 S 1350 W Suite F20, Orem, UT during open hours
- **Online:** Shop the live inventory at depop.com/oldthreadsco
- **Holds:** DM us on Instagram (@oldthreadsco_) to put a piece on hold for in-store pickup

## Cities we serve

We're located in Orem and most of our customers come from across Utah County and the broader Wasatch Front, including Provo, Lehi, American Fork, Pleasant Grove, Lindon, Springville, and Spanish Fork. We're a 5-15 minute drive from most of these cities.
